passages.text:
Hi everyone,
Apologies for the double emails, but just a friendly reminder we'd really love to get your thoughts on the key
questions/challenges for ACVFA in the DRG/AC space as well as any additional suggestions you may have for public
meeting topics (this second part can come later if needed and we will circle back with some proposals as well).
This is the working group survey we plan to send to members in the next day or two, you'll see it includes some of the
questions for the DRG/AC working group that you had previously identified, want to make sure these accurately
reflect our priorities here.
Happy to hop on another quick call if needed and thanks very much!!
Sophia
